note: Dent County, MO (29065) publishes parcels only through the BreezeMaps web-GIS viewer (dentgis.breezemaps.com), a subscription-based app with no public ArcGIS REST service or downloadable parcel file; the assessor page says bulk data requires a yearly GIS subscription. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Dent County parcels returned nothing, the MSDIS state services list no parcel layer, and the other parcel sources found are paid commercial datasets (Regrid, landrecords, Equator, Rockford Map).
